findings.finding: A fixed stale timeout can reclaim a legitimate slow owner and reopen concurrent copying.
findings.suggestion: Never time-reclaim a running claim; distinguish completion from liveness.

findings.finding: Concurrent stale rearm and mutable completion state need atomic arbitration.
findings.suggestion: Let O_EXCL arbitrate re-election and publish completion as a separate atomic sentinel. SHIPWRIGHT_VERDICT: revise

findings.finding: Ownership needs a fencing token so an old owner cannot complete or clean up a newer election.
findings.suggestion: Use an immutable claim plus token-specific atomic completion sentinel.

findings.finding: The coordination directory must be common to all 12 hooks and outside both repaired trees.
findings.suggestion: Place it under the cache marketplace root with owner-only creation where supported.

findings.finding: Raw session-id sanitization can collide or exceed filesystem limits.
findings.suggestion: Use a bounded cryptographic digest of the original id.

findings.finding: Hook-only process completion does not directly test each plugin's next shared import.
findings.suggestion: Add an immediate post-healer consumer to every process in the 12-process integration scenario.

findings.finding: Targeted evidence must include both deterministic unit and subprocess suites.
findings.suggestion: Run both commands in F0.5 evidence. SHIPWRIGHT_VERDICT: revise
